Dois computadores. A mesma rede. Seus ar: Two computers. The same network. Your files in the right place.
Use a mesma versão em ambos. Conecte os: Use the same version on both. Connect the computers to the same Wi-Fi or Ethernet network and keep Dukto open so they can find each other.
Os dispositivos disponíveis aparecem pel: Available devices appear through local discovery. Select the destination computer and the files or folders you want to share.
Confira o remetente e os itens antes de: Check the sender and items before accepting. The transfer completes after the destination confirms receipt. Your files are saved in the destination folder configured in the app.
Abra um receptor no primeiro computador: Start a receiver on the first computer and discover its identifier on the second. The CLI shares the app's protocol.
Escolha o aplicativo para o dia a dia ou: Choose the app for everyday use or the CLI for your workflow.
A primeira distribuição está em preparaç: The first distribution is being prepared. Installers will be available on GitHub Releases after review. The downloads page will list the files and architectures actually published.
O instalador será distribuído em formato: The installer will be distributed as a DMG. Open the image and copy Dukto to Applications. Choose the file for Apple Silicon or Intel. Local evaluation builds may not have an Apple signature or notarization.
Execute o instalador EXE e siga as etapa: Run the EXE installer and follow the steps. Allow private network access when Windows asks, to discover devices and receive files. Evaluation builds do not yet have an Authenticode signature.
O pacote DEB atende distribuições compat: The DEB package supports Debian/Ubuntu-compatible distributions. AppImage is a portable alternative. After downloading the AppImage, make it executable and open it.
Se você tem acesso ao repositório, insta: If you have repository access, install Rust and your platform's build tools. Run from the repository root. The CLI does not require a WebView.
De um documento a uma pasta inteira, pre: From one document to an entire folder, keep what you send organized.
A CLI aceita arquivos, pastas e seleções: The CLI accepts files, folders, and mixed selections in the same command. Folders are traversed recursively, including subfolders and empty directories.
Arquivos existentes recebem nomes altern: Existing files are given alternative names to avoid overwriting. Invalid names are adjusted for compatibility across systems. Symbolic links are skipped.
Arquivos parciais podem permanecer no de: Partial files may remain at the destination. Automatic resume is not implemented yet. Check the destination folder and start a new transfer; do not treat the progress bar alone as confirmation of completion.
A mesma transferência local, com comando: The same local transfer, with commands that fit your scripts.
A saída lista identificador, nome, plata: The output lists the identifier, name, platform, addresses, port, and protocol version of receivers found through mDNS.
Por padrão, cada envio pede aprovação no: By default, each transfer requests approval in the terminal. Use a different port from the graphical interface if both are running on the same computer.
--accept autoriza os recebimentos apenas: --accept authorizes incoming transfers only for this run. --once exits after one attempt. Without an interactive terminal, --accept is required. Use a dedicated folder for testing.
Use endereços IPv4. --timeout define o p: Use IPv4 addresses. --timeout sets the total sending deadline in seconds (default: 300). On the receiver, it limits each active connection, not idle waiting time.
--json produces one JSON event per line. The sent event includes acknowledged: true only after receiver confirmation. Exit code 0 means success; failures return a nonzero value. A continuous receiver reports receive_error and continues. --data-dir lets you isolate identities.
O Dukto encontra computadores próximos p: Dukto finds nearby computers over the local network, with no account or transfer server.
Discovery uses mDNS on UDP port 5353. Transfers use QUIC on the UDP port announced by the receiver (4242 by default). Guest networks, Wi-Fi isolation, VPNs, or firewalls may prevent devices from finding each other.
Mantenha o receptor aberto e confirme qu: Keep the receiver open and confirm both use the same protocol.
Confirme que não estão em redes isoladas: Confirm they are not on isolated or guest networks.
Verifique a liberação de mDNS e da porta: Check that the firewall allows mDNS and the receiver's UDP port.
Teste --address na CLI para separar prob: Test --address in the CLI to distinguish discovery problems from transfer problems.
No WSL2, o modo espelhado permite acesso: In WSL2, mirrored networking allows LAN access; the Hyper-V firewall must also allow the ports. In current tests, Windows and its own WSL2 transferred by address but did not discover each other. An Ubuntu VM in Multipass with bridged networking was discovered by the other environments.
Cada ambiente tem sua identidade: Each environment has its own identity
Windows e WSL2 podem compartilhar o mesm: Windows and WSL2 may share an IP, but need separate ports and have different Dukto identifiers. A bridged VM can receive its own IP on the network.
Os arquivos viajam direto entre os compu: Files travel directly between computers. You decide what to receive.
O conteúdo é transportado por QUIC com u: Content is transported over QUIC with a Noise session. The LAN flow does not send your files to a cloud storage service.
A interface pede aceitação para cada tra: The interface asks for acceptance of each transfer. In the CLI, automatic receiving requires explicit --accept. The current version has no persistent pairing or trusted device list; advertised names and IDs should not be treated as proof of a person's identity.
O protocolo 0.2 exige confirmação de rec: Protocol 0.2 requires a receipt with the identifier, item count, and byte count. Update sender and recipient together. Older apps on protocol 0.1 are not compatible with this acknowledgment.
Resultados concretos, com os limites de: Concrete results, with each environment's limits in view.
A rodada de 14 de setembro de 2026 valid: The September 14, 2026 run validated 60 CLI transfers between Windows, macOS, Ubuntu 26.04 on WSL2, and Ubuntu 26.04 on Multipass. Each direction covered one file, multiple files, one folder, multiple folders, and mixed selections. Structure, sizes, and SHA-256 were compared.
Mac e VM descobriram todos os demais. Wi: Mac and the VM discovered all other environments. Windows and WSL discovered Mac and the VM, but not each other. Direct transfer between Windows and WSL worked. This discovery issue remains open.
O que esses testes não comprovam: What these tests do not prove
Além da matriz CLI, testamos a UI do mac: Alongside the CLI matrix, we tested the macOS and Windows UIs with one large and one small file transferring concurrently in both directions, then compared their hashes. UI ↔ CLI interoperability remains untested. These results do not replace validation on other distributions, networks, or architectures.

Do not replace the desktop executable, which uses the same name; if ambiguous, use the full CLI path. Source builds still produce dukto-cli; copy it to another directory as dukto or run it directly.
